choices.why: A true light grey three-seater at 234 cm that fits the long left wall well, and its dark wood legs add warmth against the grey wood-look floor.
At 200x300 cm it is large enough to anchor the seating area, and its black and cream diamond pattern echoes the black window frames to give the room a modern look.
A light ash table with slim, splayed legs that matches the light wood look requested and stays airy on top of the patterned rug.
A low 150 cm white cabinet with walnut doors and black legs that suits the right wall, picks up the black window frames and matches the sofa's dark wood legs.
The black arc lamp in the corner reaches over the sofa with a warm linen shade, and its black finish ties in with the window frames.
A pair of cream cushions with dark diamond motifs echoes the rug, and their touches of green, orange and blue add the color the user asked for.
A tall areca palm fills the space by the balcony door with lush green and brings life to the bright room.
A pair of white sheer curtains covers the wide sliding door and softens the light while keeping the living room bright.

answer.why: A light grey sofa, light wood, white and walnut pieces keep the living room bright and modern, while the black of the rug, the lamp and the TV stand legs repeats the window frames. The palm and the cushions add the color the user wanted.
